ITEM.PTXT: The date can be set by operating the DISP switch as follows.
When setting the month digits, the year digits do not carry over even if the month exceeds "12".
When setting the day digits, the month digits do not carry over even if the day exceeds the last day of the month being set.

If a vehicle speed of approximately 1.75km/h or more is detected, date setting mode is not entered. If vehicle speed is detected during date setting, date setting mode ends, the display changes to the setting guidance screen, and timekeeping resumes from the date displayed immediately before date setting mode ended.
